header: Text on one side, links on the other
bodytext:
For a section that needs to explain itself before it lists its pages. The rich text sits in one half and the links in the other. From tablet width upwards, a switch swaps the two sides.

On smaller screens there is one column, and the intro always comes first. The switch changes the layout, never the reading order.

The four links here go to the themes made for long reading.
